properties.name: Three Pin Ridge
properties.description: An open rolling ridgeline that begins with a steeper pitch before opening out. Skier’s left offers small cliffs and chutes for experienced riders leading back into Turn Pipe.

properties.name: Broken Leg Gully
properties.description: A large natural halfpipe that funnels back toward the top of the Rangatira Express Chair. Performs best after significant snowfall.

properties.name: Valley Highway
properties.description: The main run down skier’s left of The Valley. The upper section features playful side walls while the lower section splits with options to return left to Knoll Ridge Chalet or continue straight to the base of the Valley T-Bar drive.

properties.name: Bilbos
properties.description: A short playful pipe off the Valley Highway that opens into wide terrain with natural rollers for easy airtime.

properties.name: Gollum
properties.description: A flat start that leads into a natural slalom-style slope before flowing into rolling terrain with varying pitches.

properties.name: Black Magic
properties.description: Provides expansive backcountry-style terrain and requires clear visibility. If unfamiliar with the area travel with someone experienced and check advisory signage at the top of the Far West T-Bar.

properties.name: Riveria Paradise
properties.description: Open rolling terrain with a slightly steeper pitch midway before dropping into a bowl.

properties.name: Staircase
properties.description: Rolling terrain with a steeper pitch at the end that rewards confident riding. This is a high-traffic area so keep moving where possible.

properties.name: Aeroplane Gully
properties.description: A progressively widening gully that drops into a natural pipe.

properties.name: Front Stage
properties.description: Begins with a steeper drop that builds speed before opening into wide flowing turns. This trail merges with others so take care.

properties.name: Delta Trail West
properties.description: One of two main routes to get from the Knoll Ridge side of the mountain (via the top of the Waterfall T Bar) to the West Ridge side (or vice versa). This is the easiest route to access 'out west'.

properties.name: Home Run
properties.description: The main route from the base of the West Ridge Chair back to the base area. Well suited to lower-level intermediates particularly during busy periods.

properties.name: K Road
properties.description: One of the best runs for riders stepping up from the lower mountain. K Road is wide and gentle with a small challenging pitch at the end leading to the Delta Chair.

properties.name: Rockgarden
properties.description: The main trail linking Hut Flat to the base area. Rockgarden is a self-contained run ideal for those staying close to base. This is a high-traffic zone so please ride with care and maintain a moderate speed.

properties.name: Far West Trail
properties.description: The main route from the top of the West Ridge Chair to the Far West T-Bar. Watch for merging traffic from Three Pin Ridge.

properties.name: Wizards
properties.description: The main access trail from the top of the Knoll Ridge T-Bar across to The Valley. The final slope offers a hidden gem moment with a dramatic reveal of the Pinnacles and the wider central plateau.

properties.name: Dreamer
properties.description: One of two main trails down skier’s right from the Far West T-Bar. A changing fall line moves toward and away from the lift line with varied pitch throughout.

properties.name: Far West Trail
properties.description: The main route from the top of the West Ridge Chair to the Far West T-Bar. Watch for merging traffic from Three Pin Ridge.

properties.name: Turn-Pipe
properties.description: One of two main trails down skier’s right from the Far West T-Bar. Begins with open rolling terrain before steepening midway and finishing in a large natural halfpipe.

properties.name: The Terraces
properties.description: A series of three short stages across rolling varied terrain ideal for controlled progression.

properties.name: Delta Trail East
properties.description: The easiest access route to the western terrain. One of two main traverses connecting the top of the West Ridge Chair with the top of the Delta Chair.

properties.name: Pinnacle Valley
properties.description: Begins with a steeper drop that builds speed before opening into wide flowing turns. This trail merges with others so take care.

properties.name: Tennant's Headwall
properties.description: Wide open terrain following a large pipe wall on skier’s right. Suited to fast riding with opportunities to work the wall.

properties.name: Yankee Slalom
properties.description: Open rolling country where you can step on the throttle and hit mach 10.

properties.name: Shirt Front
properties.description: Starts with great cruising terrain on the top half which then drops to a steeper pitch halfway down the run. Great first thing in the morning on the grooming if you like it hard and fast. One of two main routes down from the top of the Knoll Ridge T-Bar.

properties.name: Happy Valley Beginners Area
properties.description: New Zealand’s best place to learn to ski and home to Snowland our tubing, sledding and snowplay area. Happy Valley is a fully self-contained beginner area with its own rentals and bistro, separate from the main ski area and accessed via the base area elev

properties.name: Yankee Face
properties.description: A wide slope with a black diamond pitch at the top that eases further down. Typically features consistent bumps and performs well after fresh snowfall or in spring slush conditions.

properties.name: Murphie's Schuss
properties.description: Wide open rolling terrain best suited to settled spring conditions once the snow has softened.

properties.name: High Traverse
properties.description: A high traverse providing access to McKenzie’s Mistake. Check signage before entering as this route is for expert skiers only.

properties.name: Amphitheatre
properties.description: This is one of the biggest natural amphitheatre's on the mountain. The drop in can be a little tricky so make sure you go with someone who knows the way. Once inside you can open her up and let the boards run. At its best after a fresh dump or on a spring

properties.name: The Gut
properties.description: A large natural halfpipe on the upper section perfect for big turns before dropping into a steeper lower half suited to tighter slalom-style turns. Snowboarders can utilise the sidewalls for added speed and control.

properties.name: Mckenzie's Mistake
properties.description: A wide black diamond pitch with a nice run out at the bottom.

properties.name: Tennants Valley
properties.description: A wide open valley with rolling terrain that leads back to the base area. A quieter alternative to Rockgarden for the ski out.

properties.name: Steve's Bowl
properties.description: An open bowl located en route to the Chimney.

properties.name: Knoll Face
properties.description: Begins with wide sweeping turns before narrowing further down the run. One of two main routes down from the top of the Knoll Ridge T-Bar.

properties.name: Downhill Easy
properties.description: Rolling terrain with a few steeper undulations and varied terrain alongside the run. The main route to the base of the West Ridge Chair when travelling from the east side.

properties.name: Stebbings
properties.description: Provides access to the West Ridge area via wide open slopes. Generally sees less traffic than Cornice Bowl and is well suited to softer conditions.

properties.name: Turtle Run
properties.description: The ideal upper mountain zone for beginner intermediates stepping up from the lower mountain. Turtle Run offers a mix of terrain within a compact area making it an excellent place to build confidence and progress skills.

properties.name: Couloirs
properties.description: A steeper pitched run suited to experienced skiers and riders. Performs best after fresh snowfall or in spring conditions once the snow has softened.

properties.name: Valley Highway
properties.description: The main run down skier’s left of The Valley. The upper section features playful side walls while the lower section splits with options to return left to Knoll Ridge Chalet or continue straight to the base of the Valley T-Bar drive.

properties.name: Traverse of Fear
properties.description: The main route from the top of the Knoll Ridge T-Bar via The Gut to the West Ridge side of the mountain.

properties.name: Turner's Gully
properties.description: A narrow natural halfpipe at the top that gradually opens out and leads into the Milk Run.

properties.name: Haensil Face
properties.description: Starts with a steeper pitch before easing out toward Turtle Run. An early cut skier’s right provides access to Knoll Ridge Chalet. Well suited to riders who enjoy bumps.

properties.name: Cornice Bowl
properties.description: Begins with a slightly steeper pitch before opening into a broad bowl. One of two main routes from the Knoll Ridge side via the Traverse of Fear to the West Ridge side.

properties.name: 3rd Waterfall
properties.description: A series of three short stages across rolling varied terrain ideal for controlled progression.

properties.name: Cirque
properties.description: Begins with a traverse into a steep curved face before opening into a small bowl at the bottom.

properties.name: S Bends
properties.description: A wide open run with a reasonably steep pitch suited to fast carving and long flowing turns.

properties.name: Valley Traverse
properties.description: The main access trail from the top of the Knoll Ridge T-Bar across to The Valley. The final slope offers a hidden gem moment with a dramatic reveal of the Pinnacles and the wider central plateau.
